name: RLBench Multi-Task Workspace
description: CoppeliaSim workspace with 4 RGB-D cameras (front, left shoulder, right shoulder, wrist) overlooking a tabletop. Standard evaluation environment for PerAct, RVT, and RVT-2. 100 tasks with scripted oracle demos.

conditions.objects: task-specific (100 task variants with diverse objects)

preview_description: Franka arm at center of a tabletop workspace. Four camera viewpoints show the scene from different angles. A drawer, can, and colored blocks on the table.

name: CALVIN Tabletop
description: Language-conditioned manipulation workspace with sliding doors, drawers, buttons, LED lights, and colored blocks. 34 unique subtask types across 4 environment configurations (A-D). Standard benchmark for HULC.

conditions.surface: wooden desk with mounted fixtures (0.6m x 1.0m)
conditions.lighting: uniform overhead, 500 lux, LED indicators on desk
conditions.objects: sliding doors, drawers, buttons, colored blocks, LED lights

preview_description: Desk with colored sliding doors on the left, a drawer, three colored blocks, and a button panel. Franka arm reaches from the right side. Overhead and wrist camera views.

name: Ravens Tabletop
description: Top-down tabletop workspace in PyBullet for pick-and-place rearrangement tasks. Orthographic camera provides pixel-space action parameterization. 10 tasks from simple block stacking to complex kit assembly.

conditions.objects: colored blocks, bowls, cables, boxes, kits

preview_description: Top-down orthographic view of a tabletop with scattered colored blocks and bowls. UR5e suction gripper hovers above. Clean white background.

name: Home Doorway
description: Real-world home environment for mobile manipulation. Cabinets, doors, and drawers of varying sizes and handle types. Used for VINN door-opening experiments on Hello Robot Stretch.
preview_description: Hello Robot Stretch approaching a kitchen cabinet. Natural home lighting, wooden cabinets with metal handles. Wrist camera view shows the handle close-up.

name: Outdoor Stairs & Steps
description: Procedurally generated staircases and step terrain for quadruped and humanoid locomotion. Step heights from 5-25cm, widths 20-40cm. Tests stair climbing, descent, and transitions. Used for DreamWaQ and ANYmal research.

conditions.physics: Isaac Sim (dt=0.005s, terrain curriculum, DR on friction/mass)

preview_description: Series of concrete steps ascending. A quadruped robot mid-climb on a 15cm step. Multiple parallel environments visible in the background.
